title: Complete unverified Nostr event
description: Structure only. Requires duplicate signed-field rejection, bounded parsing, canonical ID recomputation and BIP340 verification; JSON Schema alone does not establish validity.
$comment: Unknown top-level fields are bounded and omitted from canonical signed content. Runtime requires literal unsigned integer tokens for created_at/kind (no fractional/exponent forms), strict Unicode, and source policy limits. Full events keep protocol numbers; separate metadata will use decimal strings.
